answer: A falcon-banding station on a cliff ledge stopped fake observer accounts by tying each reward to one physical perch. A volunteer must register a numbered ledge ring, record a 14-second heartbeat pulse of the banded bird on camera, and lock 7.5 coin for 31 hours. Two other volunteers replay the clip, the ring serial, and the GPS fix at 18 and 40 minutes. If one ring serial or one pulse trace appears under two accounts, both locks are burned and that ledge is closed for nine epochs.
